content.title: Genclerbirligi vs Galatasaray | HIGHLIGHTS Superlig Turkish Lig | 04/18/2026 | beIN SPORTS USA
content.text: Galatasaray Edge Genclerbirligi Away 2–1 | Title Charge Continues 🔥 Galatasaray continue their dominant run in the league with a crucial away victory over Genclerbirligi, winning 2–1 and staying firmly on track for the title race. The visitors started with intensity, fully aware of the importance of securing points. Just two minutes in, Mauro Icardi opened the scoring with a clinical finish, setting the tone early. At the 35th minute, Yunus Akgün doubled Galatasaray’s lead, giving the league leaders a strong advantage going into halftime. In the second half, Leroy Sané thought he had made it 3–0 in the 64th minute, but VAR ruled it out for offside. That decision shifted the momentum, as Genclerbirligi took advantage of Galatasaray’s brief lapse in concentration. Mbaye Niang pulled one back with a well-taken goal, reigniting hopes for the home side. Despite a desperate push for an equalizer, Genclerbirligi couldn’t break through again, and Galatasaray held on for a vital three points. With this result, Galatasaray move closer to the league title, while Genclerbirligi suffer their fifth consecutive defeat and remain dangerously close to the relegation zone.
